name: PAIR (QA + PROD)

conditions.name: PAIR API error rate
conditions.description: Unexpected (non-4xx) errors as a share of web requests. 404/405/422 are ignored and 400-403/409/429 are expected, so this is real breakage.

nrql.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND transactionType = 'Web' FACET appName

conditions.name: PAIR API p95 latency (non-streaming)
conditions.description: Seconds. Streaming endpoints (search / launch / enrich / streams) are excluded; they are long by design.

nrql.query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND transactionType = 'Web' AND name NOT LIKE '%search_jobdiva_candidates%' AND name NOT LIKE '%launch%' AND name NOT LIKE '%stream%' AND name NOT LIKE '%enrich%' FACET appName

conditions.name: PAIR API stopped reporting
conditions.description: No transactions at all (API down, agent disabled or the VM gone).

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') FACET appName

conditions.name: PAIR scheduler stopped
conditions.description: The 15-minute AutoSync job has not run for 45 minutes in any worker (APScheduler dead / lifespan failed).

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND name = 'OtherTransaction/Task/scheduler/always_on_sync' FACET appName

conditions.name: PAIR launch session failed
conditions.description: A backend-driven Source & Launch gave up after its retries. Inspect it: docs/launch-sessions.md.

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM PairLaunchSession WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND status = 'failed' FACET appName

conditions.name: PAIR launch pipeline stage failures
conditions.description: Pairbot POST / creation wait / launch batch failing repeatedly.

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM PipelineStage WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND ok IS false AND stage IN ('pairbot_post', 'pairbot_wait_creation', 'launch_batch', 'payload_generation') FACET appName, stage

conditions.name: PAIR JobDiva server errors
conditions.description: JobDiva 5xx answers (sourcing + provisioning depend on it).

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM JobDivaAPI WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND status_code >= 500 FACET appName
SELECT count(*) FROM JobDivaProfileInvariant WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') FACET appName

conditions.name: PAIR web JavaScript errors
conditions.description: Uncaught JS errors in the PAIR web app.

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM JavaScriptError WHERE appName IN ('PAIR Web (QA)', 'PAIR Web (PROD)') FACET appName

conditions.name: PAIR Exa credits exhausted
conditions.description: Exa answered 402 NO_MORE_CREDITS / API_KEY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED / TEAM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: LinkedIn-Exa and Dice sourcing and every paid Exa contact lookup are off until the account is topped up. The breaker logs 'Exa is OUT OF CREDITS' (ERROR, never sampled) once per 5-min window while it lasts. The 'Exa%' prefix keeps Apollo's own 'Apollo is OUT OF CREDITS' line out.

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE entity.name IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND message LIKE 'Exa%' AND (message LIKE '%OUT OF CREDITS%' OR message LIKE '%NO_MORE_CREDITS%' OR message LIKE '%BUDGET_EXCEEDED%') FACET entity.name

conditions.name: PAIR Exa Agent errors
conditions.description: Contact Agent runs that failed to create or poll, or a create Exa refused (400) with no fallback left, or Exa rejecting run metadata (then set EXA_RUN_METADATA_ENABLED=false). Rate limits (outcome rate_limited) and a refused Fiber data source (sources_refused, the deep search falls back to web search) are excluded. ExaCall events are not sampled.

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM ExaCall WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND endpoint IN ('agent_run', 'agent_guard') AND outcome IN ('create_error', 'poll_error', 'metadata_rejected', 'rejected') FACET appName

conditions.name: PAIR Exa contact poll timeouts
conditions.description: Share of contact Agent runs still going when we stopped waiting (billed anyway; the late watch keeps what they find). Late-watch events excluded. DISABLED until a week of ExaCall data sets a per-tier threshold (normal and deep differ): edit the threshold, then enable.

nrql.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE outcome = 'timeout') FROM ExaCall WHERE appName IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND surface = 'contact' AND endpoint = 'agent_run' AND late IS NOT true FACET appName, tier

conditions.name: PAIR Exa Pass A query failures
conditions.description: Some LinkedIn-Exa / Dice people-search queries failed and Step 5 showed a PARTIAL list (exa_service._people_search_fanout logs this at ERROR, never sampled). A run where every query ran out of credits is the credits alert instead.

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE entity.name IN ('PAIR API (QA)', 'PAIR API (PROD)') AND message LIKE 'Exa people search:%queries failed%' FACET entity.name

notes: No notification workflow is attached by default: add one in New Relic (Alerts > Workflows) pointing this policy at email/Slack.
